title: Warriors
lyrics:
[00:05.76]As a child, you would wait
[00:09.02]And watch from far away
[00:11.95]But you always knew that you'd be the one
[00:15.20]To work while they all play
[00:18.29]In youth, you'd lay awake at night, and scheme
[00:24.39]Of all the things that you would change
[00:27.59]But it was just a dream
[00:30.88]Here we are, don't turn away now (Don't turn away)
[00:37.10]We are the warriors that built this town
[00:43.21]Here we are, don't turn away now (Don't turn away)
[00:49.39]We are the warriors that built this town
[00:55.15]From dust
[00:55.26]The time will come when you'll have to rise
[01:01.31]Above the rest, and prove yourself
[01:04.39]Your spirit never dies
[01:07.53]Farewell, I've gone to take my throne above
[01:13.61]Don't weep for me 'cause this will be the labor of my love
[01:20.14]Here we are, don't turn away now (Don't turn away)
[01:26.21]We are the warriors that built this town
[01:32.41]Here we are, don't turn away now (Don't turn away)
[01:38.54]We are the warriors that built this town
[01:44.39]From dust
[02:09.30]Here we are, don't turn away now (Don't turn away)
[02:15.56]We are the warriors that built this town
[02:21.66]Here we are, don't turn away now (Don't turn away)
[02:27.85]We are the warriors that built this town
[02:33.71]From dust
